definitions.short: Jizreel , the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites
definitions.full: H3157. Yizreel יִזְרְעֶאל 1. proper name, of a location ( God soweth ; Sabean אלדֿרא Mordt ZMG 1879, 489 ; see Lag BN 131 ) — ׳י Josh 15:56 ; 2Sam 2:9 +; יִזְרְעֶ֑אל 1Sam 25:43 ; Josh 17:16 +; יִזְרְעֶ֫אלָה 19:18 6 t.: a. city in the Negeb of Judah Josh 15:56 ; 1Sam 25:43 (home of Ahinoam, one of David's wives), site unknown; compare proper name, masculine 1Chr 4:3 . b. city in Issachar Josh 19:18 on northwest spur of Mt. Gilboa 2Sam 4:4 (compare 1Sam 31:1 , 8 ) 1Kin 4:12 (compare 1Sam 31:10 , 12 ), modern Zer`în (Rob BR ii. 318 ff. Bd Pal 244 ), close to scene of great battle with Philistines 29:1 ( בְיִז אשׁר ׳בְּעַיִן , compare Rob BR ii. 323 ) 29:11 ; subject to Ishbosheth 2Sam 2:9 (yet see below), residence of Ahab and Jehoram of Israel 1Kin 18:45-46 , 21:1 (Naboth) 2Kin 8:29 (twice in verse) = 2Chr 22:6 (twice in verse), 2Kin 9:15 (twice in verse); 9:16-17 , 30 ; 10:11 compare ׳יִז דְּמֵי Hosea 1:4 , and symbolical name of Hosea's son 1:4 (compare Che); — in 2Kin 10:1 for יִז ׳שָׂרֵי read שֹׁמְרוֺן שָׂרֵי so ᵐ5 . Used by Hosea as representing Israel, with play on etymology, Hosea 2:24 (compare בָּאָרֶץ לִּי וּזְרַעְתִּיהָ Hosea 2:25), compare also יִז יוֺם ׳גָּדוֺל Hosea 1:2 . Territory immediately about the city is יִז ׳חֵלֶק 2Kin 9:10 , 36 , 37 ; compare יִז ׳חֵל 1Kin 21:23 (read probably חלק , see Th Klo after ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ; the adjacent plain is יִז ׳עֵמֶק (compare Di Josh 17:16 Bd Pal 229 ) 17:16 ; Judg 6:33 ; Hosea 1:5 (perhaps also = ׳יִז 2Sam 2:9 above, || Gilead, Ephraim, Benjamin, etc.) 2. proper name, masculine a. Hosea's son Hosea 1:4 , compare 1b above b. Judahite name 1Chr 4:3 , compare 1a above
